text: Executable preparation and 8 JVM laws pass. Native wgpu and pinned ThorVG v1.1.3 both draw an opaque rectangle on Apple M2 Pro using one actual device. ThorVG requires BGRA8 target, direct interpreter RGBA8; readback converts channel order. Original mismatched-format abort retained as evidence. Four-scale subset fixture contract frozen before expanded pixel tests. Full G-1/G-2 corpus and backend adoption remain open.
